package.description: Agentic context orchestration: git repositories and folders as a declarative context primitive for coding agents and the humans who work with them

en-US.description: Agentic context orchestration: git repositories and folders as a declarative context primitive for coding agents and the humans who work with them
en-US.longDescription:
ergo lets you declare which repositories, docs, and working folders make
up a system, then materializes that declaration into a multi-repo
workspace: cloned, organized, kept in sync, and readable by both VS Code
and terminal coding agents. One TOML file is the single source of truth;
everything on disk is derived from it and can be rebuilt at any time.
Requires git on PATH; gh (GitHub CLI) for ergo update and the code CLI
for ergo open and ergo edit are optional.
en-US.name: ergo
